body:
Maps existing background progress/control coordination and caller-connection storage on the repertoire snapshot census dependency. Records source/generation checks, Study-only admission, row locks and advisory progress handling without changing service behavior. The census remains partial.

Validation: component checker and 238 boundary/integration tests passed. Selected PGN activity-scope fixture had 24 failures on an available interpreter (18 incompatible prepare_task_claim calls and six missing storage.postgres attribute); the task-owned scheduling environment could not collect it without sqlglot. Nineteen earlier fixture failures and ten missing-adapter errors remain unresolved. Native and live behavior were not qualified.

## Summary by Sourcery

Map background activity coordination and storage ownership in the component census.

New Features:
- Add ownership census coverage for background activity coordination and storage paths.

Enhancements:
- Document the background activity source map and its known validation limitations.

Documentation:
- Update component-build documentation with the new background activity selection and validation status.

Tests:
- Extend component census integration tests to validate background activity ownership, discovery, and removal protection.

Chores:
- Update component registry and schema metadata for the additional census scope.
title: Map background activity control ownership
